red_flags: Sent landlord email promising a second quote and side-by-side comparison before a human confirmed a contractor was available
Agent noted the estimate attachment appeared to be an inspection report; reasonable, but inspection date inference (Jan 2026) is slightly speculative
reasoning: The landlord asked for a second quote and gave no approval. The agent correctly did not approve or commit any money. It acknowledged the request to the landlord, escalated to a human to source and instruct a second contractor, and placed a hold. This matches the human operator's path: note the request, assign a new provider, then hold for the second quote. The agent also spotted that the estimate attachment sent to the landlord was actually the check-out report, which is a useful catch. It did not use future information. Minor flaws: the landlord email committed to a second quote and a side-by-side comparison before anyone had confirmed a contractor could be found. The agent also did not notice that the property was vacant and so would be paused, though that fact was not visible to it. The profile fact it saved is harmless.
